mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank rate cuts, thereby boosting equity valuations via lower discount rates and higher expected future cash flows over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) below 1.5 million units over two consecutive months signals a contraction in housing demand, which triggers a broader economic slowdown and increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST falls below 1500.0 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 for three consecutive months indicates a weakening in real economic output, which increases the probability of central bank intervention to stimulate growth, leading to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO remains below 103.0 for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based contraction in private demand, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary easing and triggers a positive equity market reaction over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1500.0 and RSAFS < 480000.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, the market prices in a high-conviction monetary tightening regime, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 150,000 monthly additions signals a labor market deterioration that increases the probability of rate cuts, leading to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS < 150000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 480,000 million dollars for three consecutive months, combined with a contraction in GDP (GDPC1) on a year-over-year basis, indicates a deepening demand slump that triggers a policy response, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS < 480000.0 and GDPC1 growth < 0% YoY (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
